metadata.description: Deploys a Microsoft Sentinel workspace pre-configured for Agentic AI Security Labs (Track B and Track C).
metadata.author: Microsoft Agentic Security Labs

metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.
Azure region for all resources. Defaults to the resource group location.
Log retention in days. 30-day default keeps lab cost under $5 USD for a single day of use.
Daily ingestion cap in GB. Prevents unexpected cost overruns during lab use.

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — New Agent Registered Without Owner
properties.description: Fires when a new AI agent is registered in the tenant without an assigned owner or without an Entra Agent ID. Corresponds to lab Module 01 (Discover & Prioritize). Uses the AgentsInfo table (AIAgentsInfo was retired 1 July 2026 — see Advanced Hunting Schema Naming Changes).
properties.query:
AgentsInfo
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where CreatedDateTime > ago(1d)
| where (isnull(Owners) or array_length(Owners) == 0) or isempty(EntraAgentId)
| project AgentId, AgentName, Platform, Owners, EntraAgentId, LifecycleStatus, CreatedDateTime
| extend AlertDetail = strcat("New agent without owner: ", AgentName, " | Platform: ", Platform, " | Owners: ", iff(isnull(Owners) or array_length(Owners) == 0, "UNASSIGNED", tostring(Owners)))

properties.description: Detects potential jailbreak attempts targeting AI agents via system-instruction-override patterns in prompts. Corresponds to lab Module 05 (Detect & Respond) and KQL Library P05-Q1. Note (taught explicitly in Session 05): this is a single-turn, signature-based detector and does not catch composite/decomposed injection or paraphrased attacks — treat it as a floor, not a ceiling, and pair it with session-level aggregation (P05-Q9) and Prompt Shield.
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Application in ("Microsoft Copilot", "Copilot Studio", "Azure AI Foundry")
    and ActionType == "AgentInteraction"
| extend PromptText = tostring(RawEventData["UserPrompt"])
| extend AgentId = tostring(RawEventData["AgentId"])
| extend JailbreakScore = toint(
    (PromptText has "ignore previous instructions") * 3 +
    (PromptText has "disregard your system prompt") * 3 +
    (PromptText has "you are now a") * 2 +
    (PromptText has "act as if you have no") * 2 +
    (PromptText has "forget all previous") * 2 +
    (PromptText has "new persona:") * 2 +
    (PromptText has "DAN") * 1 +
    (PromptText has "jailbreak") * 1 +
    (PromptText has "override") * 1
)
| where JailbreakScore >= 2
| project TimeGenerated, AccountDisplayName, AgentId, JailbreakScore, PromptPreview = substring(PromptText, 0, 300), IPAddress, Application

properties.displayName: Agentic AI — Potential Bulk Data Retrieval via Agent
properties.description: Detects high-volume SharePoint file access from agent-identified user agents in a short window, which may indicate bulk retrieval or exfiltration. Corresponds to lab Module 04 (Protect Data) and KQL Library P04-Q1. Default threshold (>100 operations/10min) is a starting point — tune against your own agents' baseline before treating alerts as actionable; an unbaselined threshold will generate false positives on legitimate high-volume agents.
properties.query:
CloudAppEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where Application == "Microsoft SharePoint Online"
    and ActionType in ("FileDownloaded", "FileAccessed", "FilePreviewed")
| extend UserAgent = tostring(RawEventData["UserAgent"])
| where UserAgent has_any ("agent", "copilot", "assistant", "power-automate")
| summarize
    OperationCount = count(),
    FileList = make_set(ObjectName, 20),
    FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated)
    by AccountDisplayName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where OperationCount > 100
| extend DurationSeconds = datetime_diff('second', LastEvent, FirstEvent)
| project AccountDisplayName, OperationCount, DurationSeconds, FileList, FirstEvent, LastEvent, RiskNote = "Agent bulk access — verify against expected retrieval scope"
